item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 26/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coastal areas of southern China during the day today. Under the influence of the associated intense winter monsoon, the weather will be cold and very dry over the region early this week. It will be very cold in the morning over inland areas. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream, it will become cloudier gradually with a few light rain patches over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. However, it will remain cool in the morning and at night.

Date/Month: 26/01 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5 at first. Becoming north force 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and up to force 7 on high ground.
Weather: Becoming cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning. Bright periods during the day. Temperatures will fall appreciably later.
Temp range: 13 - 19 C
R.H. range: 50 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
